summary: Submitted a repeat of the fixed extended-window experiment (f86170361cdb4c0fb5317d016675dd6b-experiment) from its retained inputs, which is the cheapest decisive step on the only open item. That field - the demoted node's own configuration view still showing a vote at setup in two executions of that harness - has so far been sampled only twice from that construction and never reproduced by the different harness that samples the same view against the node's own log index, so a third sample from the same fixed inputs on the same executor separates a systematic property of that harness from a two-run coincidence. The repeat also yields a third independent sample of the lease-window result behind the settled VerifyLeader claim, whose interpretation remains the question's current account; the gap stays open and owned either way, and no claim in the run depends on its outcome.
